options.title: Options — Pick one of SCM UI Mockup · UI Pattern (mutually exclusive) · File attach is separate (bottom · max 5)
options.tooltip3DMockup: When 3D is checked — clicking [Select SCM UI Mockup] opens a full-screen 3D gallery (JARVIS style) that lays out mockups by category; drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Unchecked uses the regular list popup.
options.tooltip3DUiPattern: When 3D is checked — clicking [Select UI Pattern] opens a full-screen 3D gallery (JARVIS style) that lays out patterns by group; drag to rotate, wheel to zoom. Unchecked uses the regular list popup.

attach.title: Attach Reference Files — SQL · design images, etc. (drop or click)
attach.limit: Max {{max}} files · 5MB each — SQL · images · design docs, etc.
attach.tooltip: Attach up to 5 SQL files / design images / captures / source files. Text files (.sql etc.) are inlined in the prompt; images/PDF/binary are sent as attachments (max 5MB each). Can be used alongside SCM UI Mockup / UI Pattern selection.

dataSource.hint: Pick Target DB tables / SPs · T3Insight ontology · direct queries from a constellation map to specify what data the screen reads/writes (optional · independent of Mockup/UI Pattern · multi-select).

submit.moduleHint: Claude generates following the module convention (TB_{{code}}_ / SP_UI_{{code}}_).

tableLookup.title: Auto Table Existence Check (T3SMARTSCM.dbo)
tableLookup.explain: Looks up TB_* table names in your prompt directly against the backend DB — if it exists, Entity is mapped to existing columns; otherwise a new SQL_DDL artifact is generated. The result is auto-attached to the Claude prompt context.
tableLookup.noTables: (no TB_* pattern found in prompt — enter a table name if you want to use one)
tableLookup.notExists: Does not exist — a new SQL_DDL artifact will be generated (allowed in NEW_NL mode)
